mapper.sql: select scored.*, case when scored.risk_score >= 85 then '极高风险' when scored.risk_score >= 65 then '高风险' when scored.risk_score >= 45 then '中风险' else '低风险' end as risk_level, case when scored.debt_default_count > 0 then '债项违约' when scored.max_overdue_days > 90 then '严重逾期' when scored.max_overdue_days > 30 then '逾期预警' when scored.rating_numeric >= 21 then '评级触发' when scored.max_pd >= 0.100000 then 'PD 高风险' when scored.utilization_rate >= 0.9000 then '额度高占用' when scored.coverage_rate is not null and scored.coverage_rate < 0.5000 then '押品覆盖不足' when scored.blacklist_flag = 1 then '名单风险' else '常规监测' end as alert_type, case when scored.risk_score >= 85 then 'P1' when scored.risk_score >= 65 then 'P2' when scored.risk_score >= 45 then 'P3' else 'P4' end as priority from ( select base.*, case when base.blacklist_flag = 1 then 98 when base.debt_default_count > 0 then 95 when base.max_overdue_days > 90 then 90 else least(88, 10 + case when base.max_overdue_days > 60 then 35 when base.max_overdue_days > 30 then 24 when base.overdue_count > 0 then 10 else 0 end + case when base.max_pd >= 0.100000 then 25 when base.max_pd >= 0.050000 then 16 when base.max_pd >= 0.020000 then 8 else 0 end + case when base.rating_numeric >= 21 then 25 when base.rating_numeric >= 18 then 18 when base.rating_numeric >= 15 then 10 else 0 end + case when base.utilization_rate >= 0.9000 then 12 when base.utilization_rate >= 0.7500 then 6 else 0 end + case when base.coverage_rate is not null and base.coverage_rate < 0.5000 then 15 when base.coverage_rate is not null and base.coverage_rate < 1.0000 then 6 else 0 end ) end as risk_score, concat_ws('；', case when base.blacklist_flag = 1 then '黑名单标记' end, case when base.debt_default_count > 0 then concat('债项违约 ', base.debt_default_count, ' 笔') end, case when base.max_overdue_days > 0 then concat('最大逾期 ', base.max_overdue_days, ' 天') end, case when base.max_pd >= 0.050000 then concat('PD ', round(base.max_pd * 100, 2), '%') end, case when base.rating_numeric >= 18 then concat('评级 ', base.rating_level) end, case when base.utilization_rate >= 0.7500 then concat('额度占用 ', round(base.utilization_rate * 100, 2), '%') end, case when base.coverage_rate is not null and base.coverage_rate < 1.0000 then concat('押品覆盖 ', round(base.coverage_rate * 100, 2), '%') end ) as risk_signals from ( select c.customer_no, c.customer_name, ifnull(c.industry_name, '未分类') as industry_name, ifnull(c.owner_org_name, '') as owner_org_name, ifnull(c.relationship_manager_name, '') as relationship_manager_name, c.blacklist_flag, ifnull(r.rating_level, '') as rating_level, cast(nullif(regexp_replace(ifnull(r.rating_level, ''), '[^0-9]', ''), '') as unsigned) as rating_numeric, ifnull(l.total_limit_amount, 0) as total_limit_amount, ifnull(l.used_limit_amount, 0) as used_limit_amount, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) as total_secured_amount, case when ifnull(l.total_limit_amount, 0) > 0 then round(ifnull(l.used_limit_amount, 0) / l.total_limit_amount, 4) else 0 end as utilization_rate, case when ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) > 0 then round(ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) / dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 4) else null end as coverage_rate, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ifnull(ex.max_pd, 0) as max_pd, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.max_overdue_days, 0) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(ov.overdue_amount_total, 0) as overdue_amount_total, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, ifnull(dd.default_exposure_amount_total, 0) as default_exposure_amount_total, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else '' end as highest_default_level from corporate_customer c left join corporate_rating r on r.active_customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_limit l on l.active_customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no_snapshot as customer_no, sum(outstanding_principal_amount) as outstanding_principal_amount_total from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) dr on dr.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, sum(secured_amount) as total_secured_amount from corporate_credit_contract_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 and relation_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) rel on rel.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, sum(ead_amount) as ead_amount_total, sum(el_avg) as el_avg_total, max(pd) as max_pd from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) ex on ex.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as overdue_count, max(overdue_days) as max_overdue_days, sum(total_overdue_amount) as overdue_amount_total from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) ov on ov.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as debt_default_count, sum(default_exposure_amount) as default_exposure_amount_total, min(case default_level when 'A' then 1 when 'B' then 2 when 'C' then 3 else 9 end) as highest_default_rank from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and default_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) dd on dd.customer_no = c.customer_no where c.deleted_flag = 0 ) base ) scored
mapper.select:
select count(*) as customer_total, sum(risk_score >= 85) as extreme_risk_count, sum(risk_score >= 65 and risk_score < 85) as high_risk_count, sum(risk_score >= 45) as warning_customer_count, ifnull(sum(case when risk_score >= 45 then ead_amount_total else 0 end), 0) as warning_ead_amount, (select count(*) from risk_treatment_plan where status not in ('已完成', '已关闭')) as open_treatment_count from (
) risk_base
select count(*) from risk_treatment_plan where status not in ('已完成', '已关闭')

select customer_no, customer_name, industry_name, owner_org_name, relationship_manager_name, rating_level, risk_score, risk_level, priority, alert_type, risk_signals, overdue_count, max_overdue_days, debt_default_count, highest_default_level, max_pd, utilization_rate, coverage_rate, ead_amount_total, outstanding_principal_amount_total, default_exposure_amount_total from (
) risk_base where risk_score >= 45 order by risk_score desc, max_overdue_days desc, ead_amount_total desc, customer_no limit #{limit}

select * from ( select stat_date, sum(overdue_count) as overdue_count, sum(debt_default_count) as debt_default_count from ( select overdue_date as stat_date, count(*) as overdue_count, 0 as debt_default_count from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 and overdue_date is not null group by overdue_date union all select default_date as stat_date, 0 as overdue_count, count(*) as debt_default_count from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and default_date is not null group by default_date ) daily_events group by stat_date order by stat_date desc limit 14 ) recent_days order by stat_date
select id, risk_code, risk_name, `level`, status from risk_register where risk_code = #{riskCode} limit 1
select id, plan_code, risk_code, action, owner, due_date, progress, status, created_at, updated_at from risk_treatment_plan where risk_code = #{riskCode} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into risk_register (risk_code, risk_name, category, `level`, owner_department, responsible_person, status, identified_at, due_date, description) values (#{body.risk_code}, #{body.risk_name}, #{body.category}, #{body.level}, #{body.owner_department}, #{body.responsible_person}, #{body.status}, #{body.identified_at}, #{body.due_date}, #{body.description})

insert into risk_treatment_plan (plan_code, risk_code, action, owner, due_date, progress, status) values (#{body.plan_code}, #{body.risk_code}, #{body.action}, #{body.owner}, #{body.due_date}, #{body.progress}, #{body.status})
